reviewConclusions: All five primary/revised candidates and both separate diagnostic candidates passed native/4x/8x checks; none required fallback.

The reused 200000-call four-direction arm is the shortest and has the smallest maximum hit error among the five arms. Revised relay/multistart markedly reduce pressure but trade length/error; quality-score improvements are not Pareto dominance.
Revised multistart 8x undercut margin is 0.0601793513, positive but lower than the other selected candidates. No physical threshold was tightened or relaxed.

0.0005 mm beat 0.005 mm in front length/max hit/pressure on the identical saved prefix and ran 131 iterations instead of the original coarse SQP two-iteration stop. All remain local finite-difference outcomes, not proof of optimality or a SQP-family ranking.

All actual search evaluate attempts, including invalid geometry and full acceptance checks, are budgeted; cache hits, objective calls and constraint calls are not physical-call counts. Preparation and final independent checks are separate.
Per-stage allocations are remaining-budget ceilings and can reuse unused quotas; do not sum every offered allocation as if all were spent. Actual calls stay within each shared 200000 cap.
Observed seconds came from concurrent MATLAB batches and are not isolated algorithm runtime benchmarks.

Feasible incumbent acceptance uses exact full native physical/order/self-intersection gates. New modes reject dynamic weights and preserve complete non-node input. Original fmincon defaults and the overall UI default remain unchanged.
Dense-failure fallback and proposed-candidate preservation are implemented, but no final dense-failure fallback was triggered by these completed experiments.
No vehicle/body/UID/RFID or manufacturing approval is implied.
